summary: Penalty per unit of vehicle overtime.
businessRules: Scales the cost of exceeding the shift; higher discourages overtime.

vehicle_overtime_penalty defines: This parameter defines the penalty applied for every unit of time a vehicle operates beyond its scheduled time window. A higher penalty encourages the optimizer to minimize or eliminate overtime al…
Must stay consistent with: options.constraint.max_vehicle_overtime. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Vehicle's allowed_zones must include the job/shipment's zones.
This is a soft constraint. Violations are penalized but don't make solutions infeasible.
Zero means no penalty/cost; larger values increase incentive to avoid violation.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Behavioral: high penalty keeps routes within the shift.
Interaction: Positive: all jobs feasible under hard constraints + balancing options enabled -> all jobs still assigned (assert assignment count only, never the specific route distribution).
Interaction: Negative-infeasible: a job infeasible under a hard constraint (e.g. impossible time window) stays unassigned regardless of balancing weights (assert unassigned reason).
